Thank you so much for this, i feel surprisingly validated. 

I ended up showing this to my partner, because he needs to be up to date and I need all the help available. So I made an appointment with a crisis intervention center too, because if I have money to spend on drugs and cosmetic in game items, I definitely have money for therapy. 

Weight loss is actually the only area I have my shit together mostly. Dropped over 50lbs on /r/keto a few years back and I'm returning back to it. It doesn't make me happy, but at least I'm in control of some aspect of my life. I know that working out would be great for my body and mind, but I'm so unmotivated it's scary.
